model.name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 - Women's
model.description:
Work hard, play hard, and rest even harder! Lace up the Nike Zoom Vomero 5 to rise, shine, and power through your active routine in style. Featuring snappy and responsive Zoom Air cushioning, these silhouettes provide a quick-off-the-ground sensation as you head out and about. From relaxing on the couch to crushing it at the gym, these sneakers make it easy for you to go with the flow and swing into action mode.

Accented with metal tones, monochromatic neutrals, and a metallic Swoosh, these silhouettes let you stay on top of your style game. Wherever you want to go, whatever you want to do, these sneakers come with a grippy rubber outsole that keeps you ready for anything and everything. Making good times better and hard times easier, the Nike Zoom Vomero 5 is all set to earn the top spot in your sneaker collection.

Nike Zoom Vomero 5 features:

  • Real and synthetic leather upper provides long-lasting durability.
  • Mesh panels and ventilation ports on the heel deliver maximum breathability.
  • Plastic caging on the side ensures excellent support.
  • Foam midsole offers cushioning and responsiveness.

*Not intended for use as Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

Long days on your feet call for comfort that keeps up and a look that works with almost anything. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 blends cushioned support, breathable layering, and a sleek running-inspired design, making it an easy choice for everyday wear, travel, commuting, and casual gym sessions.

  • Real and synthetic leather upper adds durability and structure
  • Mesh panels and heel ventilation ports help keep airflow moving
  • Plastic side caging provides supportive containment
  • Foam midsole and Zoom Air cushioning deliver a soft, responsive ride
  • Rubber outsole adds durable traction for daily wear

Size & Fit Guidance

Most reviewers say the fit feels true to size with a comfortable, secure feel. For the best fit, we recommend starting with your usual size; if you prefer extra toe room or wear thicker socks, some shoppers found a half size up works well, while others liked the slightly roomier feel of their regular size.

Best For

Best for everyday wear, long walks, commuting, travel, and long hours on your feet when comfort and style matter equally.

Styling & Versatility

The layered upper, sculpted midsole, and heritage running lines give this pair a standout look that still feels easy to wear day after day. Reviewers love how easily it dresses up or down and pairs with everything from workout sets to everyday outfits.

Break-In & Durability

Most reviewers say the comfort shows up right away with little to no break-in needed. Some note it feels even better after a few wears, making it a strong option for regular rotation.

Care & Maintenance

To keep the mixed-material upper looking its best, spot clean gently and let it air dry. Regular light cleaning can help preserve the finish and keep the shoe looking fresh for everyday wear.

sizeChart.sizeChartTipTx:
Unfortunately, there is no international sizing standard. Sizes vary from country to country. Please use the tables above only as a guide to help you in ordering the correct size. Please note that all sizes, are listed and sold in US sizes., |

Women's shoes are made on a narrower last (the foot-shaped form used in making shoes) than men's. In addition, the heel on a woman's shoe is narrower than the forefoot width. Men's shoes have the same width at the forefoot and heel. The medium width for women's shoes is B, while the medium width for men's shoes is D.

Women can wear men's shoes by converting their size to men's by subtracting 1.5 from their numeric size. For example, if you are a size 8 in women's, you would try a 6.5 in men's sizes. This is a loose conversion and doesn't change the difference in width and forefoot-to-heel ratios.

, | If you still have questions about fit or sizing please contact Customer Service., | If your measurements fall between two sizes, choose the smaller size for a tighter fit or the larger size for a looser fit.
